items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Willie Smith was supposed to go on that, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's beautiful. I was just thinking that I know everybody in that band.
Yeah... Willie Smith was supposed to go on that, you know. Earle Warren went in his place, because Willie died. Just the day before we left, he died.
x(This refers to the "Jazz From A Swinging Era" tour.)
